# @revealui/cache

> 标签: adapters, cache, invalidation, pglite, revealui

## 简介

Cache store adapters, tag-aware createCachedFunction/revalidate*, and distributed invalidation for RevealUI.

## 官网

- 官网：https://revealui.com
- 源码仓库：git+https://github.com/RevealUIStudio/revealui.git
- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@revealui/cache
